body.name: Two-layer overlap chart synchronization
body.construction: Order \(\mathcal B_n\) lexicographically, let \(b_0\) be first, put \(\mathcal V_n=\mathcal B_n\), and compute \(\Pi_r((X_n^{(1)})_{C_bP_b})=\widehat U_b\widehat S_b\widehat V_b^{\top}\), where \(\widehat U_b\in\mathbb R^{|C_b|\times r}\), \(\widehat S_b\in\mathbb R^{r\times r}\), and \(\widehat V_b\in\mathbb R^{|P_b|\times r}\), using zero padding and the lexicographic singular bases fixed by \(\Pi_r\) if the observed rank is below \(r\). Join \(b<c\) precisely when \(R_{bc}=C_b\cap C_c\) and \(S_{bc}=P_b\cap P_c\) both have cardinality at least \(r\), and set \(w_{bc}=|R_{bc}|/N_n+|S_{bc}|/T_n\) and \(d_b=\sum_{c:\{b,c\}\in\mathcal E_n}w_{bc}\). The conformable row and column overlap frames are \(H^U_{b,bc}=\operatorname{qf}_r((\widehat U_b)_{R_{bc},\cdot})\in\mathbb R^{|R_{bc}|\times r}\) and \(H^V_{b,bc}=\operatorname{qf}_r((\widehat V_b)_{S_{bc},\cdot})\in\mathbb R^{|S_{bc}|\times r}\). Define \(\widehat O^U_{bc}=\operatorname{polar}_r((H^U_{b,bc})^{\top}H^U_{c,bc})\) and \(\widehat O^V_{bc}=\operatorname{polar}_r((H^V_{b,bc})^{\top}H^V_{c,bc})\), each in \(\mathsf O(r)\), and put \(\widehat O^Z_{cb}=\widehat O^{Z\top}_{bc}\). For \(Z\in\{U,V\}\), the normalized connection Laplacian is the \((r|\mathcal B_n|)\)-square block matrix with \(\mathcal L^Z_{bb}=I_r\), \(\mathcal L^Z_{bc}=-w_{bc}\widehat O^Z_{bc}/\sqrt{d_bd_c}\) on edges, and zero off edges; equivalently it represents the objective \(\sum_{b<c}w_{bc}\lVert Q_b^Z-\widehat O^Z_{bc}Q_c^Z\rVert_F^2\). Select the lexicographically first orthonormal basis of its bottom \(r\)-dimensional eigenspace, block it as \(\widetilde Q_b^Z\in\mathbb R^{r\times r}\), set \(\widehat Q_{b_0}^Z=I_r\), and for \(b\ne b_0\) set \(\widehat Q_b^Z=\operatorname{polar}_r(\widetilde Q_b^Z(\widetilde Q_{b_0}^Z)^{\top})\). If a chart core or required overlap has fewer than \(r\) indices, some \(d_b=0\), or the scalar graph is disconnected, the construction returns the global fallback specified in Definition \ref{def:wedge-spectral-procedure}; hence synchronization is defined on every input. When \( |\mathcal B_n|=1\), set \(\widehat Q_{b_0}^U=\widehat Q_{b_0}^V=I_r\), declare the scalar graph connected, and use synchronization amplification one; no normalized-Laplacian eigenvalue is evaluated.
